doors.question: Is my job or my grocery bill caught up in this?
doors.title: For people, workers and families
doors.lede: Plain language, no codes. Most Canadian trade is not caught up in this. What follows is what is actually in force, what changes in September, and what is worth asking this week.
doors.description: In plain language: which measures are actually in force, what changes next, and what is worth asking this week if you are worried about your job or your grocery bill.

doors.question: Does tomorrow's purchase order change?
doors.title: For small businesses, traders and contractors
doors.lede: What changes on a quote, a purchase order or a shipment. Narrow by sector if you want only what touches you. Nothing here classifies your goods; that is a job for a licensed broker.
doors.description: What the measures in force change on a quote, a purchase order or a shipment, narrowed by sector, with the primary source for each one.

doors.question: What does this mean for where I live?
doors.title: The GTA lens on a national fact base
doors.lede: The same national measures everyone else on this site is reading, just read through the Greater Toronto Area, starting with Brampton and Peel. Peel is a logistics and auto-parts region, which puts it closer to the centre of this than most of the country.
doors.description: The same national fact base as the other three doors, read through the GTA, starting with Brampton and Peel, a logistics and auto-parts region closer to the centre of this than most of the country.

doors.question: What is the legal basis and the national picture?
doors.title: The legal basis and the national picture
doors.lede: Authority, coverage, mechanism, and which instrument still has to be published before anything is operational. The smallest of the four doors, because this space is already well served.
doors.description: Legal authority, coverage, mechanism, and which instruments still have to be published before anything is operational.
